newsitem.title: JAPAN: Forval, Uny set up discount call venture.
newsitem.headline: Forval, Uny set up discount call venture.

text.p: Forval Corp, a distributor of telephones, said on Monday that it and chain store operator Uny Co Ltd had set up a joint venture to offer discount domestic and international calls.
The venture, UF Communications Inc, was capitalised at 200 million yen and is 60 percent owned by Forval and the rest by Uny, Forval said in a statement.

The new firm will also sell cellular phones and the personal handyphones used in the Personal Handyphone System, a Japan-developed cellular phone system that is cheaper than conventional portable phones.
The new firm aims for sales of one billion yen in its first year of operation and five billion yen by the third year.
